Therefore, B offers the most reliable generalization for this trend‑dominated, highly predictable series.

decision.top3_why: The trimmed‑mean strategy (trim_pct = 0.2) over the stable pool2 removes the most extreme model forecasts while still leveraging the bulk of the models that show consistent performance. decision.top3_why_not: A (weighted inverse error) relies on estimated weights that are highly variable when model rankings are unstable; it performed best only in the first window and worst in the third, indicating over‑fitting to the validation noise.  C (median) is robust but discards useful information from the better‑performing models; its per‑window scores are consistently lower than the trimmed‑mean, especially in the middle window.  Therefore, B offers the most reliable generalization for this trend‑dominated, highly predictable series.
